title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring Uruguayan-style grilled beef skewers with a crispy crust.

ingredients.name: skewers (10-12 inches)
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: Thread beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with black pepper and garlic powder (if using).
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with Uruguayan chimichurri sauce and a side of grilled pineapple (if using).
